follow-up time: Until death, emigration, gynecological cancer diagnosis, radical or unspecified hysterectomy, or December 31, 2018, whichever came first
cohort: Women born in Denmark between 1947 and 2000 who underwent hysterectomy between 1977 and 2018, matched 1:5 to reference women based on age and year of hysterectomy
finding: Hysterectomy, regardless of surgical route, was associated with an increased risk of pelvic organ prolapse surgery, particularly in the posterior compartment, and this risk increased with the number of vaginal births.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections did not seem to increase the risk of prolapse surgery.
